source_clauses.route: Complete proof in principal.tex Proposition 1

source_clauses.claim: Avoiding individual parabolics alone is described as enough to complete affine quotient classification.
source_clauses.route: The accepted affine A2 translation example satisfies local injection but is a one-chamber quotient. Pair-product avoidance and full flag validity are additional requirements; arbitrary normal translation subgroups do not automatically give hypertopes.

source_clauses.claim: Avoiding individual parabolics alone is described as enough to complete affine quotient classification.
source_clauses.route: The accepted affine A2 translation example satisfies local injection but is a one-chamber quotient. Pair-product avoidance and full flag validity are additional requirements; arbitrary normal translation subgroups do not automatically give hypertopes.

source_clauses.claim: Corn-Singerman regular hypermap/universal triangle rotation presentation.
source_clauses.route: Retain attribution[10] and the orientation-preserving triangle presentation; the new full reflection-group finite-existence proof does not reproduce every historical hypermap construction.
The accepted arbitrary-large finite same-diagram theorem requires rank>=3. A finite quotient of infinite dihedral group has finite pair order and a different diagram.
